assumptions.assumption: The lobby is internet-facing because it must be reachable from wherever a player is and is described as exposed.
assumptions.basis: The source says the client talks to the lobby and that both the lobby and game servers have to be reachable from wherever a player is, so they are exposed.

assumptions.assumption: The game server is internet-facing because it must be reachable from wherever a player is and is described as exposed.
assumptions.basis: The source says the client talks directly to the game servers and that both the lobby and game servers have to be reachable from wherever a player is, so they are exposed.
